cards.card_text: And the scouts top it all off with one more line: "We even saw the descendants of the Anakim there." The Anakim were a people known for being tall (Deuteronomy 2:10).
cards.verse_text: We even saw the descendants of the Anakim there.’”
cards.snippet: We even saw the descendants of the Anakim there.’”

cards.card_text: The people there are strong and tall, the descendants of the Anakim, and they've heard it said: "Who can stand up to the sons of Anak?"
cards.verse_text: The people are strong and tall, the descendants of the Anakim.
cards.snippet: The people are strong and tall, the descendants of the Anakim.

cards.card_text: At that time, Joshua turns to the Anakim, a people great and tall (Deuteronomy 9:2).
cards.verse_text: At that time Joshua proceeded to eliminate the Anakim from the hill country of Hebron, Debir, and Anab, and from all the hill country of Judah and of Israel.
cards.snippet: At that time Joshua proceeded to eliminate the Anakim from the hill country of Hebron, Debir, and Anab, and from all…

cards.card_text: No Anakim are left in the land of the Israelites.
cards.verse_text: No Anakim were left in the land of the Israelites; only in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod did any survive.
cards.snippet: No Anakim were left in the land of the Israelites; only in Gaza, Gath,…

cards.card_text: Now Caleb asks for the hill country the LORD promised him that day, and he reminds Joshua that the Anakim were there, with great and fortified cities.
cards.verse_text: Now therefore give me this hill country that the LORD promised me on that day, for you yourself heard then that the Anakim were there, with great and fortified cities.
cards.snippet: …promised me on that day, for you yourself heard then that the Anakim were there, with great and fortified cities.

cards.card_text: The Anakim in that hill country have great and fortified cities.
cards.verse_text: Now therefore give me this hill country that the LORD promised me on that day, for you yourself heard then that the Anakim were there, with great and fortified cities.
cards.snippet: …promised me on that day, for you yourself heard then that the Anakim were there, with great and fortified cities.

cards.verse_text: (Hebron used to be called Kiriath-arba, after Arba, the greatest man among the Anakim.) Then the land had rest from war.
cards.snippet: …used to be called Kiriath-arba, after Arba, the greatest man among the Anakim.) Then the land had rest from war.
